# SwitchU v1.4.2 ## Flip-Grip, Lock Sign-in, PlayGuard Integration, Expanded Folder Options, Customizable Heroes & System Polish A major feature and polish release bringing portrait Flip-Grip HOME support, updated Frame Tap integration for multi-orientation support, optional Lock Sign-in, PlayGuard integration, improved controller compatibility, more accurate TV display sizing, docked performance fix, expanded folder interactions, customizable game artwork, and Hungarian localization. --- ## 🗞 What's New & Fixed ### Flip-Grip / TATE Portrait HOME Orientation - **Portrait HOME** - Added portrait orientation support while maintaining the native 1280×720 framebuffer. The interface reflows into a logical 720×1280 layout for Rot90 / Rot270, with orientation-aware touch, stick, and cursor input. - **Orientation Controls** - Switch orientation using the new HOME orientation button and L3 stick click shortcut (off by default), or adjust the orientation once in Settings → Display → HOME Orientation. - **Complete Portrait UI Overhaul** - Redesigned and adapted the entire SwitchU interface for portrait orientation with tabs arranged on top to save space. - **Cycle overlay tabs** - Added cycling tabs with L/R in addition to navigating Theme Shop shelves with and ZL/ZR (in both landscape and portrait). - **Portrait Grid Optimization** - Oversized HOME tiles automatically shrink to fit the active portrait grid (e.g. 4×2 → 2×2 on a 3×5 grid), without changing their saved tile sizes. Tiles such as 2×3 retain their original size whenever they fit. - **Landscape Layout Preservation** - Portrait mode uses a compact, page-preserving projection of your landscape layout by default. Switching orientations won't rearrange your existing landscape layout or introduce unnecessary pages. - **Separate Portrait Layout** - Organize portrait and landscape layouts independently in Settings → Display (off by default). Disable it at any time to return to the landscape-derived portrait layout.

### Flip-Grip Support Updates > [!IMPORTANT] > **Status:** The following updates are available in Frame Tap [v0.7.24-beta1](https://github.com/TomasUribe/switch-frame-tap/releases/tag/v0.7.24-beta1), please update to enjoy these new features. - **Viewer Orientation** - Added support for rotating the streamed display through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°, allowing Frame Tap to match SwitchU's Flip-Grip/TATE orientations! - **Customizable Rotation Cycle** - Choose which orientations are included in the rotation cycle, with independent enable/disable options for 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. At least two orientations must be enabled when the cycle button is active. - **Automatic Window Aspect Ratio** - Windowed mode automatically adjusts to 16:9 in landscape and 9:16 in portrait, keeping the viewer properly proportioned when rotating. detail.readme:
# SwitchU ### Wii U/3DS style custom home menu for Nintendo Switch


---

Screenshots  ·  Features  ·  Installation  ·  Themes & Icon Workshop  ·  SwitchU Manager  ·  How to build  ·  Known issues  ·  Contributing  ·  Credits  ·  License

## Screenshots
More screenshots Folders in Grid and Single-row views Hero and Posters displayed for Titles Quick Settings Side bar with built in Music player Alternate tiles sizes in grid view Themesshop with community submitted themes and icon packs
## ✨ Features | Area | What you get | |------|----------------| | **Home menu** | Wii U-inspired browsing, folders, posters / tile sizes, touch + trigger navigation | | **Theme Shop** | Browse, preview, and install community themes + icon packs (with tint modes) | | **Theme Studio** | Build and submit themes / icon packs from the web
[![Open Theme Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_Theme_Studio-6364EE?style=for-the-badge)](https://polonx.github.io/SwitchU-Themes/) | **SteamGridDB** | Covers, heroes, posters - search missing artwork from Settings | | **Lock Screen** | Clock fonts, transitions, optional Sign-in (PIN / password / pattern / combo), resume from suspended game, Lock from Power / Quick Settings | | **Music** | Quick Settings player, playlists, fullscreen player - put tracks in `sdmc:/switch/SwitchU/music/` | | **Languages** | Full HOME chrome for English + European packs, plus **Japanese / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / Korean** (shared system fonts for CJK glyphs) | | **Frame Tap** | Optional USB HOME capture with [Switch Frame Tap](https://github.com/TomasUribe/switch-frame-tap) (see below) | | **Battery Saver** | Dial back visuals to save power (also used when Frame Tap viewer needs headroom) | | **Manager** | Enable / disable SwitchU; in-app updates after you are on 1.4.0+ | > [!TIP] > Correct console time/date matters for SteamGridDB HTTPS. Use Settings timezone / NTP sync if artwork search fails. > [!NOTE] > **Forgot Lock Sign-in?** Delete `sdmc:/config/SwitchU/lock_auth.bin` on the SD card, then reopen HOME. Sign-in is a privacy lock (sibling / shared console), not CFW-hard security — anyone with SD access can clear it. ## 💿 Installation 1. Download the latest **SwitchU** release ZIP from [Releases](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU/releases/latest). 2. Extract it to the **root of your SD card**, merging the `atmosphere/` and `switch/` folders. 3. Eject the SD safely, then **reboot** into Atmosphere. ### Final layout ```text sdmc:/ ├── atmosphere/ ← sysmodule / exosphere pieces from the release └── switch/ └── SwitchU/ ├── SwitchU-Manager.nro ├── music/ ← optional local music library └── ... ``` ## 🎨 Themes & Icon Workshop Create themes, download packages, and submit icon packs here: [![Open Theme Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_Theme_Studio-6364EE?style=for-the-badge)](https://polonx.github.io/SwitchU-Themes/) | On the site | On the Switch | |-------------|----------------| | Browse the live catalog and download `.zip` themes | Open **Theme Shop** from the HOME menu | | Live preview editor (colors, backgrounds, fonts, audio) | Apply themes / icon packs from Installed | | Submit themes or icon packs via GitHub sign-in | Theme Shop pulls the community catalog online | ### Manual theme install 1. Download a theme zip from Theme Studio (or Save draft as zip). 2. Unzip so you have a folder with `theme.json` inside. 3. Copy that folder to: ```text sdmc:/switch/SwitchU/themes// ← preferred for manual installs sdmc:/config/SwitchU/themes// ← Theme Shop install root (also still works) ``` 4. Open **Theme Shop → Installed** and apply it. > [!NOTE] > Theme Shop installs still write under `config/`. If the same theme id exists in both places, **config wins**. Icon packs install under `sdmc:/switch/SwitchU/icons/`. Catalog source repo: [PoloNX/SwitchU-Themes](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU-Themes). ## 📹 Frame Tap (optional) Stream the SwitchU HOME menu to a PC over USB with **[Switch Frame Tap](https://github.com/TomasUribe/switch-frame-tap)** (v0.7.21.1 or later). 1. Install Frame Tap per its release notes. 2. In **Frame Tap Manager → Beta**, turn **Stream the HOME menu** ON (`home_menu = 1`). 3. Reboot, then connect the Viewer. SwitchU enables **Battery Saver** automatically while the Viewer needs headroom so both can share available memory. ## 🧰 SwitchU Manager `SwitchU-Manager.nro` (under `sdmc:/switch/SwitchU/`) lets you **enable or disable** SwitchU without deleting files. ## ⚠️ Known issues - Some settings are not implemented yet. - While sysmodules modules are now supported - some sysmodules or heavy stacks can still cause memory issues that result in failed boots, black screens or other issues like the clock not working. - To add more head room for sys-modules you can also try [Born to Honk's Atmosphere fork](https://github.com/borntohonk/Atmosphere/releases/tag/1.12.1+) (when setup correctly it can reclaim more memory on Firmware 20+ and doesn't need sys-patch which can be dropped from the stack) - Screenshots in this README may lag the newest UI; see [release notes](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU/releases) for the latest visuals. ## 🤝 Contributing Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. - Open an [issue](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU/issues) when something breaks. - Open a PR when you have a fix or improvement. - Theme / icon creators: use [Theme Studio](https://polonx.github.io/SwitchU-Themes/) to submit packages. ## 🔨 How to build ### Requirements - [devkitPro](https://devkitpro.org/wiki/Getting_Started) - [Xmake](https://xmake.io/#/) ### Clone ```bash git clone --recursive https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU cd SwitchU ``` ### Build (production daemon + external menu mode) ```bash xmake f -p cross --toolchain=devkita64 --homebrew=n --backend=deko3d xmake ``` ### Build (homebrew .nro mode) ```bash xmake f -p cross --toolchain=devkita64 --homebrew=y --backend=deko3d xmake ``` ### Clean ```bash xmake clean ``` Build outputs are generated under `build/cross/aarch64//`. ## 👾 Credits - [PoloNX](https://github.com/PoloNX) and everyone who ships SwitchU - [Xortroll](https://github.com/Xortroll) / [uLaunch](https://github.com/Xortroll/uLaunch) for inspiration and help early on - Theme and icon contributors via [SwitchU-Themes](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU-Themes) - Community testers and PR authors across the release history ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. See [LICENSE](https://github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU/blob/master/LICENSE) for details.
